login.title: Log In
login.subtitle: Welcome back. Log in to continue to your Madar account.
login.serverError: Could not connect to the server.
login.alreadySignedInBody: You can continue to your dashboard or log out and use another account.
login.mfaRequired: Enter your authenticator code to finish signing in.
login.mfaRecommended: Signed in. MFA enrollment is recommended for this admin account.
login.mfaSubtitle: Use your authenticator app to finish signing in.
login.mfaFailed: Could not verify the MFA code.
login.emailNotVerified: Please verify your email before logging in.

signup.title: Register
signup.subtitle: Start building dashboards, pages, and reports with Madar.
signup.termsRequired: You must agree to the Terms and Conditions to create an account.
signup.verifyEmail: Account created. Check your email and verify it before logging in.
signup.passwordInvalid: Password must be at least 8 characters.
signup.alreadyRegistered: This email is already registered. Please log in.
signup.businessTypePlaceholder: e.g. Restaurant, clinic, or creative agency
signup.subdomainTooShort: Hosted-address name must be at least 3 characters.
signup.subdomainInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only. Start and end with a letter or number.
signup.subdomainTaken: This hosted-address name is already taken.
signup.onboardingSuccess: Account created. Please log in to continue.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot Password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a reset link.
forgotPassword.success: Reset link sent! Check your email.
forgotPassword.notFound: This email is not registered. Please sign up first.

resetPassword.title: Reset Password
resetPassword.subtitle: Enter your new password below.
resetPassword.passwordShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
resetPassword.expired: This password reset link has expired. Request a new link.
resetPassword.replayed: This password reset link has already been used. Request a new link.
resetPassword.inProgress: This password reset is already being processed. Request a new link if it does not finish.

verification.title: Verify your email
verification.pendingBody: Open the verification link we sent before logging in.
verification.spamHelp: Check your spam or junk folder if the message has not arrived.
verification.resent: If this account is awaiting verification, a new email has been sent.
verification.resendLimited: Please wait before requesting another verification email.
verification.checkAgain: I've verified my email — check again
verification.providerUnavailable: Email verification is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
verification.codeExchangeUnavailable: This verification link format cannot be completed here. Request a new verification email.

checking.title: Checking verification
checking.body: We are confirming your email securely with the identity provider.

pending.title: Check your inbox
pending.body: Your account is still waiting for email verification.

unknown.title: Check your inbox
unknown.body: Use the newest verification email, then check again.

verified.title: Email verified
verified.body: Your email ownership has been confirmed. You can continue to login.

expired.title: Verification link expired
expired.body: Request a new verification email to continue.

invalid.title: Verification link is invalid
invalid.body: The link could not be verified. Request a new email and use its newest link.

provider_unavailable.title: Verification is temporarily unavailable
provider_unavailable.body: Your account has not been marked verified. Try again or request a new email.

validation.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
validation.passwordLength: Password must be at least 8 characters.
